title.zh: Bankers sue to overturn OCC trust-bank rule used by crypto firms
title.en: Bankers sue to overturn OCC trust-bank rule used by crypto firms

current_state.zh: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
current_state.en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.
